note: Reference-only industry AI use cases gathered from public sources to inform the curated industry profiles. They do not select or define any build composition; type mappings are post-hoc analyst hypotheses. Some pages were verified only through search snippets or secondary sources.

cases.title: Discovery AI hyper-personalized banking assistant
cases.description: Discovery Bank (South Africa) built a generative-AI assistant on Azure OpenAI and Databricks that gives every client tailored 'next-best-action' financial recommendations and equips service agents with personalized customer insight.
cases.reported_impact: Reported by Microsoft: doubled client engagement with 'next best action' recommendations and reduced response latency by over 50%.

cases.title: Automated call summarization for contact-center associates
cases.description: Ally Financial uses Azure OpenAI Service to automatically draft post-call notes and summaries for customer service associates, reducing manual admin work after each call.
cases.reported_impact: Reported by Microsoft: tens of thousands of call summaries produced per week, freeing associates to focus on customers.

cases.title: Copilot Studio-powered banking chatbot
cases.description: ABN AMRO upgraded its Dutch-language customer chatbot using Microsoft Copilot Studio, Azure, and Power BI to more accurately resolve requests across millions of customer conversations.
cases.reported_impact: Reported by Microsoft: scaled support for over 3.5 million customer conversations while reducing operational/maintenance costs.

cases.title: Governed API platform for teller and underwriting gen-AI tools
cases.description: Wells Fargo uses Google Cloud Apigee to govern reusable APIs behind a teller-facing RAG assistant for policy lookups and a Document AI tool that supports underwriting.
capability_gaps: API/model governance and versioning (not in catalog)
cases.reported_impact: Reported by source (search synthesis of Google Cloud materials): branch banker query resolution time cut by roughly 20%.

cases.title: Omni-channel gen-AI banking chatbot
cases.description: Vietnam's Cake Digital Bank built an omni-channel conversational assistant on Vertex AI to deliver personalized natural-language customer service across its digital banking app.

cases.title: Gemini-powered customer support and trade-ops document AI
cases.description: Hong Leong Bank (Malaysia) deployed a Gemini 2.5 Flash chatbot for customer queries and Document AI for trade-finance operations, run as a private, governed instance.
cases.reported_impact: Reported by Google Cloud: chatbot reaches ~99% accuracy and handles 67% of customer support queries.

cases.title: AXA Secure GPT internal generative-AI platform
cases.description: AXA built 'AXA Secure GPT' on Azure OpenAI Service to let employees across 14 countries summarize, translate, and generate text, images, and code within a compliant, secured environment.
cases.reported_impact: Reported by Microsoft: platform built and rolled out to AXA Group Operations employees in 14 countries within three months.

cases.title: Claims call summarization app
cases.description: Markerstudy Group, a UK motor insurer, built an Azure OpenAI-powered app that automatically drafts summaries of complex claims calls for its claims handlers, with a human always reviewing for accuracy.
cases.reported_impact: Reported by Microsoft: ~300 claims handlers save about 4 minutes per call, totaling roughly 56,000 hours (~7,500 working days) a year across 840,000 annual calls.

cases.title: AI Factory for scaling generative-AI use cases
cases.description: French mutual insurer Groupama ran a Microsoft-supported hackathon and then created an internal 'AI Factory' on Azure OpenAI Service to move dozens of generative-AI use cases (claims, customer service) from pilot to production.
cases.reported_impact: Reported by Microsoft: 25+ generative-AI use cases in development, moving swiftly from hackathon pilots to production.

cases.title: Risk-submission digitization for underwriters
cases.description: Cytora's SaaS platform, built on Google Cloud generative-AI foundation models, automatically parses risk submissions arriving as PDFs, emails, and spreadsheets and turns them into decision-ready, structured data for insurance underwriters.
cases.reported_impact: Reported by Google Cloud: broker response times reduced from days to hours or minutes.

cases.title: Generative-AI features embedded in insurer core platforms
cases.description: Insurance-software vendor Sapiens partnered with Microsoft to embed Azure OpenAI and Power Virtual Agents into its SaaS platforms, letting insurer clients automate customer service, claims/fraud workflows, and underwriter document review.

cases.title: Hospital-wide generative-AI assistant (ERIOS)
cases.description: France's Montpellier University Hospital deployed Azure OpenAI Service and Copilot Studio to power the 'ERIOS Assistant,' which drafts patient documents, anonymizes notes, and flags patients eligible for clinical research.
cases.reported_impact: Reported by Microsoft: supports 12,000 hospital staff across care pathways, documentation, and research operations.

cases.title: MedScribe appeal-letter drafting assistant
cases.description: Acentra Health built 'MedScribe' on Azure OpenAI Service to draft healthcare service-appeal letters for nurses, cutting the time needed to complete Medicare appeal documentation.
cases.reported_impact: Reported by Microsoft: cut nurse letter-drafting time by 50%, saving about 11,000 nursing hours and nearly $800,000 in six months, with a 99% approval rate.

cases.title: Clinician and patient generative-AI initiatives
cases.description: US health system Mercy is working with Microsoft Azure OpenAI Service to help patients understand lab results, assist scheduling/follow-up communications, and give staff a chatbot for HR/policy questions.
cases.reported_impact: Reported by Microsoft: over a dozen generative-AI initiatives launched across the health system to improve care speed and efficiency.

cases.title: Bedrock Agents for automated drug-research screening
cases.description: Genentech uses Amazon Bedrock Agents to automate parts of drug-candidate screening and interaction simulation, aiming to shorten R&D cycles.

cases.title: Development Assistant for clinical trial data
cases.description: AstraZeneca built a natural-language 'Development Assistant' on Amazon Bedrock so researchers and clinicians can query large clinical-trial datasets conversationally for faster insight.

cases.title: MRI foundation model for radiology
cases.description: GE HealthCare launched an MRI foundation model built with AWS generative AI to help radiologists interpret images and identify abnormalities faster.
capability_gaps: medical image interpretation (vision/multimodal, out of catalog scope)

cases.title: Manufacturing Copilot for knowledge access and maintenance
cases.description: Sandvik built a 'Manufacturing Copilot' on Azure OpenAI Service and Azure AI Search that lets employees and customers query decades of product documentation in natural language and surfaces predictive-maintenance insights.
cases.reported_impact: Reported by Microsoft: up to 30% improvement in productivity.

cases.title: Unified plant data with conversational troubleshooting
cases.description: Bridgestone unified IT/OT factory data with Microsoft Fabric and an Azure AI agent that lets factory teams query production data and troubleshoot issues in natural language, supporting predictive maintenance.
cases.reported_impact: Reported by Microsoft: reduced production downtime and waste across global plants.

cases.title: 800+ AI agents across factory operations
cases.description: GE Appliances deployed over 800 AI agents built on Google Cloud's Gemini Enterprise, embedded in its 'Brilliant Factory' data platform, letting frontline workers query production and quality data conversationally.
capability_gaps: low-code agent orchestration platform (out of catalog scope)
cases.reported_impact: Reported by Google Cloud: root-cause analysis of shift/production issues now completed in minutes instead of longer manual review.

cases.title: Digital-thread AI for engine design and maintenance
cases.description: Rolls-Royce uses Microsoft Cloud for Manufacturing (Azure and Databricks) to connect engineering, production, and engine-health data for predictive maintenance and design optimization.
cases.reported_impact: Reported by Microsoft (via search synthesis): 30% increase in machine usage and prevention of ~400 unplanned maintenance events annually.

cases.title: Generative product-design and quoting engine for furniture manufacturers
cases.description: New Math Data built an Amazon Bedrock-powered context engine that generates custom furniture product images matching buyer preferences and automates quote preparation for furniture manufacturer clients.
capability_gaps: generative image synthesis (out of catalog scope)
cases.reported_impact: Reported by source: reduced proposal creation time by over 90%, moving from proof-of-concept to production within six weeks.

cases.title: Gen-AI shopping assistant for meal planning and basket building
cases.description: Kroger adopted Google Cloud's Gemini Enterprise platform to power a shopping assistant that turns natural-language dietary requests into recipes and ready-to-purchase baskets using live inventory and pricing.

cases.title: Gemini-powered 'algotorial' shopper curation
cases.description: Etsy uses Gemini models with Vertex AI, BigQuery, and Dataflow to generate personalized product-trend collections (e.g., themed Home-feed curations) for each of its ~90 million buyers.
capability_gaps: large-scale vector similarity infrastructure (implementation detail, not user-facing type)
cases.reported_impact: Reported by Google Cloud: curation at scale boosts listings shown per theme by 80x.

cases.title: Gemini Enterprise shopping assistants and review summarization
cases.description: Best Buy uses Google Cloud's Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform to power human-like shopping assistants, generate product Q&A, and summarize customer reviews online.

cases.title: Gemini-powered catalog enrichment and visual search
cases.description: Wayfair applies Gemini models to automate catalog-data enrichment, power visual product search, and co-develop an agentic 'Universal Commerce Protocol' for shopping interactions.
capability_gaps: image-based visual search (multimodal, out of catalog scope)

cases.title: Chefbot recipe-to-basket personal shopping assistant
cases.description: Central Retail Group's Tops supermarket chain built a Gemini-powered chatbot ('Chefbot') that turns customer recipe preferences into shoppable grocery lists mapped to 50,000+ SKUs for personal shoppers.
cases.reported_impact: Reported by Google Cloud: personal shoppers save time per order, enabling more cross-selling/upselling.

cases.title: Native voice-shopping assistant
cases.description: European online retailer OTTO built a voice-based shopping assistant on Google Cloud's Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform offering expert product advisory across millions of items.
capability_gaps: speech recognition/voice interface (out of catalog scope)

cases.title: Advanced Smart Assistant for grid and device management
cases.description: Iberdrola built over 100 generative-AI applications on AWS, including an Advanced Smart Assistant (ASA) that manages smart devices and supports real-time IT incident management for its clean-energy operations.
cases.reported_impact: Reported by AWS: ASA delivers up to a 30% reduction in smart device energy consumption.

cases.title: Generative AI for energy-trading reconciliation
cases.description: TotalEnergies uses generative AI on AWS to provide real-time insight and automate reconciliation in its energy-trading operations, reducing errors and financial risk.

cases.title: AI-accelerated IT service desk
cases.description: Enel integrated a generative-AI solution with AWS and ServiceNow to cut IT service-desk resolution times from hours to minutes.
cases.reported_impact: Reported by AWS: IT service desk resolution accelerated from hours to minutes.

cases.title: Field-technician generative AI support
cases.description: SOLV Energy partnered with AWS and Effectual to give field technicians generative-AI tools for documentation lookup and automated call-center support, improving productivity.

cases.title: Agentic AI for grid-interconnection studies
cases.description: Duke Energy worked with AWS on an agentic-AI program that automates grid-interconnection study preparation, turning weeks of manual data work into hours for engineers.
cases.reported_impact: Reported by Amazon: interconnection study data preparation reduced from weeks to hours.

cases.organization: UK Civil Service (UK Government, Department for Work and Pensions, Companies House)
cases.title: Microsoft 365 Copilot productivity trial
cases.description: The UK government piloted Microsoft 365 Copilot with 20,000+ civil servants across twelve departments to draft documents, summarize meetings, answer routine customer queries (Companies House), and personalize jobseeker advice (DWP).
cases.reported_impact: Reported by Microsoft/UK Government: average time saved of 26 minutes/day per civil servant, equivalent to freeing up over 1,000 full-time workers across the trial.

cases.title: Searchable e-Publishing knowledge base
cases.description: A small U.S. Air Force team used Vertex AI Search & Conversation to make thousands of e-Publishing PDF regulations searchable via chatbot and portal within 90 days.
cases.reported_impact: Reported by Google Public Sector: deployed within 90 days, reducing time Airmen spend on administrative document search.

cases.organization: New York State (Medicaid, DMV, Sullivan County)
cases.title: Citizen-service chatbots and Medicaid process automation
cases.description: New York State agencies (Medicaid, DMV, Sullivan County) used Google Cloud Vertex AI to build citizen-facing chatbots and streamline healthcare/DMV service processes.

cases.title: Gen-AI tools for 27,000+ city employees
cases.description: The City of Los Angeles equipped over 27,000 government employees with Google Gemini and NotebookLM to reduce cognitive load, aid policy communication, and streamline internal operations serving 4+ million residents.
capability_gaps: multi-document notebook synthesis as distinct tool

cases.title: Gemini for Government agent platform
cases.description: The U.S. DoD's GenAI.mil program built over 100,000 AI agents on Google's Gemini for Government platform, used by over a million personnel to automate mission-critical workflows.
cases.reported_impact: Reported by source: over 100,000 AI agents built, used by more than one million users.

cases.title: TelClaude domain-tuned customer-service agent
cases.description: SK Telecom worked with the AWS Generative AI Innovation Center to fine-tune Anthropic's Claude for Korean-language, telecom-domain customer service, automating resolutions across support interactions.

cases.title: Automated metadata tagging for enterprise data
cases.description: Nordic telecom Telia partnered with Accenture on AWS Bedrock to automatically generate metadata tags and descriptions across its data warehouses, unlocking data-driven decision-making.
capability_gaps: data-catalog/lineage automation (structured metadata generation, not passage extraction)
cases.reported_impact: Reported by Accenture: generated metadata for 87,000 data fields, saving ~10,000 data-engineer hours and €700,000.

cases.title: Multiple generative-AI solutions on Amazon Bedrock
cases.description: Taiwan's Chunghwa Telecom built several generative-AI solutions on Amazon Bedrock, emphasizing faster, more secure deployment across its telecom operations.
capability_gaps: multi-solution governance across telecom business units

cases.title: Ask Telstra and One Sentence Summary agent tools
cases.description: Telstra built two Azure OpenAI Service tools — 'Ask Telstra' for agent knowledge-base Q&A and 'One Sentence Summary' for condensing support tickets/calls — to speed up customer service.
cases.reported_impact: Reported by Microsoft: 90% of employees using One Sentence Summary reported time savings; 20% reduction in follow-up contact; 84% of agents said Ask Telstra improved customer interactions.

cases.title: Centralized generative-AI program across business lines
cases.description: French telecom Orange built a centralized generative-AI program on Azure OpenAI Service and GitHub Copilot spanning customer service, marketing, communications, and network operations use cases.
cases.reported_impact: Reported by Microsoft: rolled out use cases within six months of program launch.

cases.title: Legal-domain AI platform on Azure
cases.description: Harvey, an AI platform used by hundreds of law firms, runs on Azure OpenAI/GPT-4 infrastructure to summarize contracts, support due diligence, and perform legal research with case-law referencing.

cases.title: Clifford Chance Assist and Microsoft 365 Copilot rollout
cases.description: Global law firm Clifford Chance built 'Clifford Chance Assist' on Azure OpenAI and rolled out Microsoft 365 Copilot/Viva Suite firmwide to automate meeting summaries, drafting, and email management, with lawyer review of all AI output.

cases.title: Cross-border case support with Microsoft 365 Copilot
cases.description: DWF Law uses Microsoft 365 Copilot to automate translation and generate first-draft presentations for cross-border legal cases.

cases.title: Percy AI in-house legal generative-AI platform
cases.description: Global law firm Simmons & Simmons built 'Percy AI' on Azure OpenAI GPT-4 with retrieval-augmented generation to summarize lengthy transcripts, compare witness statements, and surface inconsistencies for fee-earners firmwide.
capability_gaps: multi-document contradiction detection as distinct capability
cases.reported_impact: Reported by Microsoft: 87% of fee earners use Percy daily, with ~5,000 prompts/day from 2,500 staff; a 550-page transcript summarized in seconds versus hours manually.

cases.title: Legal document modernization with Amazon Textract
cases.description: UK financial/insurance firm Legal & General modernized legal document management using Amazon Textract and SageMaker to speed up processing and ensure compliant handling of customer documents.
cases.reported_impact: Reported by AWS: processed 1,000 documents concurrently within 30 minutes.

cases.title: Microsoft 365 Copilot deployment for staff productivity
cases.description: University of Manchester deployed Microsoft 365 Copilot to roughly 300 academic and back-office staff for document creation and productivity gains.

cases.title: Predictive student-support models and mathbot
cases.description: Babson College modernized with Microsoft Copilot, Azure AI, and Microsoft 365 to build predictive models for student support and a 'mathbot' tool aiding STEM learning.

cases.title: Troby knowledge-base agent for staff
cases.description: La Trobe University built the 'Troby' agent with Microsoft Copilot Studio to help staff navigate knowledge scattered across multiple internal systems, with plans to extend to students.
capability_gaps: intent-routing across disparate knowledge systems as distinct capability

cases.title: Microsoft 365 Copilot pilot for IT staff
cases.description: University of Oxford's IT Services department piloted Microsoft 365 Copilot with 400+ staff for document summarization, content creation, and accessibility support for neurodiverse users.

cases.title: Archie AI math tutor and Gemini-powered learning simulations
cases.description: ASU built 'Archie,' a Gemini-powered chatbot that gives K-12 students in ASU Prep real-time hints and error feedback on math problems, alongside Unreal Engine learning simulations on Google Cloud.
cases.reported_impact: Reported by Google Cloud: increased the number of times students got the right answer after using hint/error feedback functions.

cases.title: AI-driven demand forecasting and fulfillment orchestration
cases.description: Amazon uses AI across its North American sortation-center network for SKU-level demand forecasting, inventory allocation, and labor-schedule automation for over 100,000 associates.

cases.title: Generative AI for RFQ assessment and proposal creation
cases.description: DHL Supply Chain, with Boston Consulting Group, launched generative-AI tools that read and assess RFQs, cleanse inbound data, and support tailored sales-proposal creation.

cases.title: ORION AI-optimized delivery routing

cases.source_publisher: Think4AI (industry analysis citing UPS public disclosures)

cases.title: Nina AI customer-service assistant
cases.description: FedEx's 'Nina' AI assistant handles millions of customer queries about shipments and delivery status with high first-contact resolution.
cases.source_publisher: Think4AI (industry analysis citing FedEx public disclosures)
cases.reported_impact: Widely reported (as cited by source): over 80% first-contact resolution rate.

cases.title: SabreMosaic AI-powered offer and search platform
cases.description: Travel-technology leader Sabre built 'SabreMosaic' and its 'Sabre IQ' intelligence layer on Google Cloud AI to deliver dynamic, personalized airline ancillary/upgrade offers and improved market-demand forecasting.
cases.reported_impact: Reported by Google Cloud: up to 10% higher ancillary revenue, up to 20% higher seat-upgrade revenue, and up to 7% better market forecasting.

cases.title: Generative-AI trip planning in the mobile app
cases.description: IHG Hotels & Resorts used Google Cloud's Vertex AI and Gemini models to build a generative-AI trip-planning feature in its mobile app that delivers personalized itineraries and adjusts them to live events.

cases.title: AI.g airline-scale customer service assistant
cases.description: Air India built 'AI.g' on Azure OpenAI Service, described as an airline-scale generative-AI customer-service solution handling flight-change, refund, and pet-travel queries with context-aware, empathetic responses.
cases.reported_impact: Reported by Microsoft: handles ~40,000 daily chat interactions across 1,300+ query types, resolving over 13 million conversations with a 97% success rate.

cases.title: Multi-LLM property data distribution strategy
